name: math-quiz
description: Firebase mathematics quizzes, problem bank and teaching workspace

scripts.test:backend: npm run prepare:backend && npm --prefix functions test
scripts.test:integration: npm run prepare:backend && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-mathquiz-v2 --only auth,firestore,storage "node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration/*.test.mjs tests/rules/*.test.mjs"
scripts.emulators: npm run prepare:backend && firebase emulators:start --project demo-mathquiz-v2
scripts.test:transport: npm run prepare:backend && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-mathquiz-v2 --only auth,firestore,storage "node --test --test-reporter=spec tests/transport/*.test.mjs"
scripts.qa:capture: npm run prepare:backend && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-mathquiz-v2 --only auth,firestore,storage "node tests/qa/capture.mjs"
